title: 2009 HMMT February General Round 1 Problem 4
statement: If \(\tan x+\tan y=4\) and \(\cot x+\cot y=5\), compute \(\tan (x+y)\).

solutions.text: We have \(\cot x+\cot y=\frac{\tan x+\tan y}{\tan x \tan y}\), so \(\tan x \tan y=\frac{4}{5}\). Thus, by the tan addition formula, \(\tan (x+y)=\frac{\tan x+\tan y}{1-\tan x \tan y}=20\).
